title: Joint product-pair mass
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n\ge 0$, and let $\rho\in[0,1]$. For sequences $x,y\in\Omega^n$, their joint mass under the retention-and-resampling experiment is the mass of $x$ under the product distribution $\pi^{\otimes n}$ multiplied by the conditional mass of $y$ given $x$ under the product noise kernel.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
